Prospective, interventional, open-label, single-arm study · NCT06910306 · patients treated to date at The Ohio State University Comprehensive Cancer Center 12 20 patients planned sample size of the study 8 patients treated to date all eight alive as of Nov 11, 2026 6 reached response assessment reported in the interim analysis at SNO 12 mo planned follow-up per patient Endpoints Primary: feasibility (deployment of all planned sources with planned tumor dose coverage) and safety (serious adverse events within 90 days) Secondary: radiographic tumor response (RANO criteria) and overall survival Eligibility Recurrent glioblastoma (IDH-wildtype, grade 4 glioma) Up to 3 recurrences Tumor smaller than 3 cm Prior course of central nervous system radiation Treatment Stereotactic intratumoral implantation of titanium sources loaded with radium-224, using the Alpha radial applicator Image-guided placement through minimally invasive burr-hole access, without requiring open craniotomy Enrollment and patient status are interim results as of November 11, 2026.

REGAIN · presented at the SNO 2026 Annual Meeting 26 PRESENTED AT THE SNO 2026 Annual Meeting · Philadelphia, Nov 12-15 What the data show Feasible: all planned sources deployed in 8 of 8 patients (100%) Safety: no unanticipated serious adverse events; one grade 3 seizure, resolved Survival: all 8 patients alive; median follow- up 6.9 months from enrollment (3.1 to 11.6); median overall survival not reached Response: 6 of 6 objective responses; 5 complete, 1 partial What is still being evaluated Necrosis, all asymptomatic, seen or suspected on follow-up imaging in 4 of 6 patients In 2 patients it is too early to tell necrosis from progression near or outside the treated area 1 patient has progressed away from the treated area; no recurrence reported within it What comes next More scans over the coming months, and one planned biopsy, expected to clarify the open imaging questions Continue enrollment toward 20 patients Longer follow-up on durability of response and survival Additional interim data anticipated in early 2027 Interim results as of November 11, 2026.
